```{python}
#| label: retraction-scatterplot
#| fig-cap: "A scatterplot of retracted papers"

import pandas

import retractionpy
from retractionpy.load import read_dataset
from retractionpy.preprocessing import clean_dataset
from retractionpy.visualisations import plot_scatter_retraction_dates

df_oecd_countries = pandas.read_csv("data/oecd_countries.csv")
oecd_countries_list = df_oecd_countries["Name"].to_list()

df = clean_dataset(read_dataset())
#plot_scatter_retraction_dates(df[(df["Country"].isin(oecd_countries_list)) & (df["RetractionDate"] > pandas.Timestamp("2000-01-01"))])
plot_scatter_retraction_dates(df[(df["Country"].isin(oecd_countries_list))])
```

```{python}
import rpy2
from rpy2.robjects.packages import importr, data

utils = importr('utils')
base = importr('base')

utils.chooseCRANmirror(ind=1)
utils.install_packages('retractionwatch')

retractionwatch = importr('retractionwatch')

retractionwatch.load_retraction_data("data/retraction_watch.csv")

sjr_country_counts = retractionwatch.build_sjr_country_counts("data/sjr_rankings")
oecd_countries = retractionwatch.load_oecd_countries("data/oecd_countries.csv")
retraction_data = retractionwatch.load_retraction_data("data/retraction_watch.csv")
publication_counts = retractionwatch.publication_counts_by_class(sjr_country_counts, oecd_countries)

print(oecd_countries)
```
